description: This file provides Windows-specific implementations for memory mapping functions, specifically 'git_mmap' and 'git_munmap', for the git project. It interfaces with Windows API functions to perform low-level file mapping operations.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Provides a Windows-specific implementation of memory mapping a file, similar to POSIX mmap, using Windows API functions.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Unmaps a previously mapped memory region using Windows API's UnmapViewOfFile.

ctags.name: git_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^void *git_mmap(void *start, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)$/
ctags.signature: (void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
